chunks: And Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
"Do not lodge women in upper rooms, nor teach them writing, nor teach them Sūrat Yūsuf; and teach them spinning and Sūrat al-Nūr.
And when a woman performs tasbīḥ, she should count upon the fingertips, for they will be questioned on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.الْأَنَامِلِ: fingertips or finger joints used for counting

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about teaching women and counting tasbīḥ on the fingers?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructions concerning women's conduct, what they should be taught, and the practice of counting tasbīḥ on the fingers. It also links the use of the fingers in dhikr to accountability on the Day of Judgment.
